April 17, 2018 - By Darrin Black 
Ctc Llc increased its stake in Netflix Inc (NFLX) by 654.38% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ctc Llc bought 179,594 shares as the company’s stock rose 58.31% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 207,039 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $39.74M, up from 27,445 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ctc Llc who had been investing in Netflix Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $133.56 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.24% or $3.87 during the last trading session, reaching $307.78. About 15.39M shares traded or 28.17% up from the average. Netflix, Inc. (NASDAQ:NFLX) has risen 108.73% since April 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 97.18% the S&P500.
